scene.text: Traditional Chinese ink-and-watercolour painting: confident dark ink-brush linework, loose expressive brushwork, soft bleeding colour washes, visible paper grain. Faces, hands and skin are built the same way as everything else — flat washes and visible brushstrokes, edges left unresolved where the brush lifted. Extreme close-up of a cigarette lighter — a metal flip-top lighter held between bare fingers — being ignited, with a small orange and white flame visible at the top of the mechanism. The lighter body is chrome or silver-toned metal with a visible hinge and strike wheel. The setting is indeterminate and dark, with a near-black background.
